name: Pietro Antonio Maletta
bioAdditions: An 'Antonius Maletta' was buried at San Mango on 22 November 1702 (S1). He is a candidate for Pietro Antonio; the tree has 24 November 1702.

conflicts.assessment: Probably the same man; check image.
